features: Fixes remote projector refresh so feed buttons update the live display via AJAX without reloading the controller
Live Display now polls every 750ms and forces a fresh projection iframe whenever session state_version changes
Adds cache-busting state parameters so repeated feed selections cannot reuse a stale projection frame
Makes generated Live Display URL retrievable on the operator screen after page reload or screen-setting changes
Allows the separate projector PC to render projection feeds using its secure display token without requiring an admin login
Adds Results Reveal Safety lock protecting Final Ranking and Winner Podium from accidental public display
Unlock Results Reveal requires explicit operator confirmation and safe feed switches automatically relock protected results
Final Ranking is explicitly ordered by official final_rank ascending from 1st through 5th
Final Ranking now uses the same podium-style visual hierarchy as Winner Podium
Podium display includes available competitor photos and country flags while missing/broken photos remain display-only blank space
Mirrors secure live-display token support and podium ranking rendering into Test projection
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
